v15_marker_labels.description: Two markers with different labels. The chat reply for each must carry its own label; the MARK records are the cross-check.

v15_traced.description: A traced bundle with one delayed command. Expect three BUNDLE_STEP records in index order, the second showing dueTick and elapsedTicks about 20 greater than the first.

v15_untraced_control.description: The same shape without trace. Expect no BUNDLE_STEP record between its boundaries.
